mapper.select: SELECT script_sha256 FROM ad_billing_schema_history WHERE version=18
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_billing_recovery_command(command_id,advertiser_id,budget_date,family,action,target_id,reason,actor) VALUES(#{command.commandId},#{command.advertiserId},#{command.budgetDate},#{command.family},#{command.action},#{command.targetId},#{command.reason},#{command.actor}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT command_id,advertiser_id,budget_date,family,action,target_id,reason,actor,status,created_at,completed_at FROM ad_billing_recovery_command WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND advertiser_id=#{advertiserId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_billing_recovery_command SET status=#{status},completed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE command_id=#{command.commandId} AND advertiser_id=#{command.advertiserId} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT o.event_id FROM o JOIN l ON l.ledger_id=o.event_id WHERE o.event_id=#{command.targetId} AND l.advertiser_id=#{command.advertiserId} AND l.budget_date=#{command.budgetDate} FOR UPDATE OF o

choose.when: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ad_click_settlement s JOIN ad_click_quote q ON q.quote_id=s.qualification_id WHERE s.qualification_id=l.qualification_id AND q.advertiser_id=l.advertiser_id AND s.budget_date=l.budget_date AND s.state='CAPTURED' AND s.ledger_id=l.ledger_id AND q.amount=l.amount)

EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ad_conversion_settlement s JOIN ad_conversion_quote q ON q.quote_id=s.qualification_id WHERE s.qualification_id=l.qualification_id AND s.advertiser_id=l.advertiser_id AND s.budget_date=l.budget_date AND s.state='CAPTURED' AND s.ledger_id=l.ledger_id AND q.amount=l.amount)
choose.otherwise: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ad_budget_reservation r WHERE r.reservation_id=l.qualification_id AND r.advertiser_id=l.advertiser_id AND r.budget_date=l.budget_date AND r.state='CAPTURED' AND r.amount=l.amount)

mapper.select: SELECT l.ledger_id event_id,l.qualification_id,l.amount,o.delivery_state,o.destination,o.partition_key,o.payload_json, obligation_matches,f.event_id IS NOT NULL fact_present, coalesce(f.qualification_id=l.qualification_id AND f.advertiser_id=l.advertiser_id AND f.budget_date=l.budget_date AND f.amount=l.amount,false) fact_matches,f.payload_hash fact_hash FROM l LEFT JOIN o ON o.event_id=l.ledger_id LEFT JOIN f ON f.event_id=l.ledger_id WHERE l.ledger_id=#{command.targetId} AND l.advertiser_id=#{command.advertiserId} AND l.budget_date=#{command.budgetDate}
mapper.update: UPDATE SET delivery_state='READY',attempts=0,fence=fence+1,available_at=clock_timestamp(),last_error=NULL,published_at=NULL WHERE event_id=#{targetId} AND (delivery_state='DEAD' OR (delivery_state='PUBLISHED' AND published_at<=clock_timestamp()-#{waitSeconds}*interval '1 second'))
